error_reason: The Architect agent (Bob) repeatedly failed to execute the action to write the architecture documentation. In Turn 5, the agent stated it would write files to markdown paths but the JSON command was truncated and no file content was generated. This led to a state where, in Turns 8 and 9, the agent incorrectly assumed the design work was complete without actually having created the required files, while the Team Leader repeatedly forwarded the message. The root cause is the failure to follow the role specification of an agent who must produce tangible outputs (design files) rather than just stating intentions.
